title: iGSM multi-pass training (1x, 2x, 4x) at 300M, 520M and 1.2B
status: registered before any run of this extension; see REGISTRATION_4SCALE.json for the timestamp and SHA256
request: User task list of 2026-11-21, item 1: extend E1X4 (existing: 130M, both sources, 2 blocks) to 300M, 520M, 1.2B.
existing_version: DESIGN_E1X4.md (2026-10-27), results E1X4_RESULTS.json (130M). Everything not named under 'what_changes' is that protocol.

scope.blocks: rotations k0 and k2 of order seed 20261022 (the 130M block definition)

protocol_identical_to_130m.data: 2x = the E1 schedules k0/k2 of order seed 20261022 traversed twice (contract RR-surface-v4-E1long); 4x = traversed four times (contract RR-surface-v4-E1x4). Pass 1 equals E1; train, dev and probe files are the E1 files; every family sees 2x / 4x its E1 exposures with the same parents.
protocol_identical_to_130m.schedule: 48 warmup steps, cosine decay to 0.1 of the peak over the full horizon; every run starts from the pretrained base model, never from a shorter run.
protocol_identical_to_130m.probes_and_scoring: M, G1, G2 at every level; greedy decoding, official full-solution check; M gold NLL at every evaluation step.

what_changes.matmul_precision: tf32 (as the iGSM main experiment at these scales; 130M used fp32)
what_changes.trainer: the scale-study trainer with the E1long / E1x4 data contract

learning_rates.rule: The learning rate selected for one-pass training at that scale and source (the 130M rule: the 682-step selected values, not retuned).
learning_rates.spectral: the learning rates selected in E4F for spectral_p05 and spectral_p1 at that scale and source (E4F_SPECTRAL_LR_DECISION.json). Spectral cells are registered only after that decision exists; AdamW and Muon cells run first.

cells.reused_not_rerun: 1x adamw and muon: the main-experiment cells of the same blocks (k0-o22: the selected learning-rate grid cell; k2-o22: the E1 cell). 1x spectral: the E4F spectral cells of the same blocks.
cells.order: per scale: adamw/muon 2x, adamw/muon 4x, then spectral 4x once the E4F decision exists

primary_quantities.level: most frequent level; G2 at the final step of each budget, mean over k0 and k2, paired by family and rotation
primary_quantities.interval: 95% family-cluster bootstrap, 2000 draws, as in E1X4
per_scale_and_source: muon - adamw at x1, x2, x4
primary_quantities.stability: an arm is stable if |G2(2728) - G2(2000)| <= 5 pp; a comparison with an unstable arm is labelled 'still moving'
primary_quantities.readings: as DESIGN_E1X4.md: gap persists at 4x if the interval of muon - adamw excludes 0 below; closed if it includes 0 and |difference| <= 5 pp; otherwise inconclusive. Spectral: advantage persists if the interval of p1 - muon excludes 0 above in both sources.

outputs.result_file: E1X4_RESULTS.json with the existing structure (primary, levels, stability); keys prefixed with the scale, e.g. '<scale>/A/muon-adamw'
outputs.package: MuonPaperData_<date>_E1X4_<scale>.zip: result JSON, per-checkpoint tables, training curves, learning rates used, analysis scripts, this file, SHA256 list. No user, institution or host name in paths or contents.

execution.host_class: a100 for 300m, 520m and 1.2b (recorded in each campaign)
execution.weights: final-step weights are kept until the dW spectra are computed and one block (k0-o22) is exported
